entries.a4b45bd61407e16d: The company’s management philosophy is “to solve customers’ challenges through the world’s highest-level technological capabilities and creativity cultivated through entertainment, together with human resources services, and to strive to contribute to society,” and it conducts its business under the corporate concept “EnterNext.” In the Development Promotion and Support Business, the company is expanding into non-entertainment areas by leveraging knowledge of 3DCG technology and game engines, and it provides the machine learning solution “BENZaiTEN” and DX support services using digital twins. It also states that it will pursue new customer development in industrial fields such as manufacturing and heavy industry, automobiles and mobility, and civil engineering and construction, as well as aerospace, space and defense, healthcare, and security and crime prevention. In the Human Resources Business, the company states that it will expand its placement business by promoting intensive sales efforts with existing clients.
